page.layout: One page of text, centred. Running head at the top with the page number at left. Below the text, a signature block: "D. V.", then an italic closing line with the editor's name at right.

main_text.p: fent,publicarem & in lucem ederem. Vobis vero,illustres ac generosi comites,hunc patris mei charissimi laborem dedicare volui, primum quidem, ut meam erga vos observantiam hoc qualicunq; argumento testarer. Deinde vero, quod eorum quae damus lectionem vobis hac fané aetate vestra neq; iniucundam, neq; infructuosam fore putaui. Postremo,quod hoc Opusculum gratius fore studiosis existimaui, si sub amplissimi nominis vestri patrocinio ederetur. Quapropter vehementer rogamus, Illustres ac Generosi Domini comites, ut haec qualiacunque eo quo mittimus animo accipiatis. Bene in Christo Iesu valete,& me meosq; commendatos habete. Marpurgi, 7 idus Septemb. Anno 1 5 6 8.

page.notes: The right margin shows faint show-through from the reverse side and is left out. A dark mark at the top right beside the running head is a stain, not printed. The page number is an ornamental "6" and is marked [?]. The year is printed with spaced digits, given as "1 5 6 8.". The closing line and the editor's name are set in italic.
